In a paired comparison with the same checkpoint and public task, DeepSeek V4 Pro achieved an 865/964 official check pass rate in 30.37% of the wall-clock time used by GLM-5.3. This end-to-end efficiency result does not, however, estimate a guidance effect. The V105 Code trace records a guidance trigger entering the archived request, followed by autonomous model actions, readback, and a 17/17 pass. In R12 (88 HTTP requests, 109 hesitation-frontier observations), all observations were flagged as novel, yet no hesitation direction was triggered; a separate production-progress diagnostic delivered feedback across five domains. In the Web domain, no required-artifact advancement was witnessed for the first fourteen actions, despite continuous novel returns. Feedback was queued after action three and delivered after action nine, with verified artifacts appearing at actions fifteen through seventeen. These records establish both an operational guidance mechanism and a coverage boundary of novelty-based monitoring. While \\\"pseudo-productivity\\\" remains a diagnostic hypothesis requiring task-relevance review, the evidence demonstrates that observational novelty is not a sufficient condition for task progress. WAKE✳︎ GOVERNANCE
================

This module is the mechanical rulebook for WAKE✳︎.

The model is allowed to PROPOSE changes to durable state.
It is never allowed to decide whether those changes are valid.

That distinction is central to the experiment:

    model output = proposal
    governance = authority
    durable state = accepted history

The functions in this file are deliberately deterministic. Given the same
state and the same proposal, governance should reach the same decision
regardless of which model produced the proposal.

A model cannot persuade this module, reinterpret its instructions, waive a
requirement, or edit the rules during an invocation.

A research transition is atomic: an invalid research action rejects that
transition without partial writes. application_policy.py owns the separate
editorial wrapper, which can withhold an invalid final blog while committing
independently valid research. Do not move that exception into the reducer.

This gives WAKE✳︎ an important property:

    failure can become durable information
    without failure becoming durable state.
"""
